reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "200 mg" on the front, and then that it is two capsules of 100 mg each, so it is not what the big number suggests. I stick with Pure Encapsulations, Thorne or Nature Made, and this is a new brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal.
